description: This file defines the Mail class in the OpenCart system, providing an abstraction over various mail adaptors for sending emails within the application.

classes.name: Mail
classes.description: Provides methods to configure and send emails using pluggable adaptors in the OpenCart system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Mail object with a specified adaptor, dynamically instantiating the corresponding class.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the plain text content of the email.

methods.name: setHtml
methods.description: Sets the HTML content of the email.

methods.name: addAttachment
methods.description: Adds a file attachment to the email.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends the email via the selected adaptor.
